reflections.adjustment: For game 3, revise the four brought: remove Choice Scarf from Aegislash (replace item/build or swap it out), do not bring/evolve Medicham, and bring Dragonite (Multiscale/Lum) and/or Houndstone (Fluffy/Leftovers) from the bench to check spread and priority; avoid leading with paired Ground-weak mons and plan around Sneasler Fake Out.

Future plan: never Choice-lock Aegislash; do not mega Medicham against this opponent; prioritize spread-resistant/priority-checking options (Dragonite, Houndstone); lead should avoid double Ground weakness and account for high opponent Protect usage and Fake Out openers.
